subject: general
question: Who among the following long jumpers won the first-ever silver medal for India in the long jump at Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Murali Sreeshankar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Murali Sreeshankar** won the first-ever silver medal for India in the **long jump** at commonwealth games **2022.**
 
• He achieved a jump of** 8.22 meters **in the final round, which was his personal best.
 
• Sreeshankar had previously won a** gold medal **at the **2016 South Asian Games** in the long jump event.
 
• He is considered one of the most promising athletes in India and has been training under the guidance of his father, who is also a **former long jumper.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Niraj Upadhyay** is a **javelin thrower.**

 
 
• He won a **silver medal **at the** 2022 Commonwealth Games** in the men's javelin throw event.
 
 
 
• **Saurav Ghoshal** is a **squash player **who has represented India at various international tournaments and won several medals.
 
 
• After winning the 77th National Squash Championship, he was crowned the **national champion in 2020. **
